stem: A hospital network keeps most of its imaging archive on premises but wants radiology workstations to mount a standard NFS file share, with the bulk of the data durably stored in Amazon S3 and only recently viewed studies cached locally for fast reads.

choices.text: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway in cached volume mode
Amazon S3 File Gateway configured as an NFS share
Amazon FSx File Gateway for on-premises access to FSx for Windows File Server

rationale: S3 File Gateway presents an NFS or SMB file share backed by an S3 bucket, with a local cache for low-latency access to recently used files, matching this exact pattern. Volume Gateway in cached volume mode presents iSCSI block volumes rather than an NFS file share, so it does not give the workstations the mount point they need. Tape Gateway presents a virtual tape library to backup software, not a file share for workstations. FSx File Gateway is for accessing FSx for Windows File Server from on premises and is no longer available to new customers.
